title: Chekiang

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 349
Date 20/5/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

May 18th 1916.

Sir,
The Chekiang Authorities have sent agents to Shanghai who are endeavouring to buy arms and ammunition.
A number of brokers are busy on this account and they report that in Shanghai there can be purchased 12 machine guns with 5000 rounds of ammunition for each at a total cost of $2000.00 and 15,000 Mauser rifles of the German 1888 pattern with 500 rounds of ammunition for each at a cost of $60 per weapon.
The machine guns belong, it is alleged, to a German; the owner of the rifles is not known but the weapons are said to be stored in a godown in Pootung.
The price asked is higher than the Chekiang people is willing to give as they have an offer of 25000 Japanese rifles with 800 rounds of cartridges, for 30 Yen a piece. These rifles are in Japan but the offer will be accepted if the money can be raised.
A Japanese firm bearing the name of Takata & Co No.8 Museum Road is reported to have 750 rifles with bayonets, belts, and 250 rounds of ammunition which are stored in a godown at Pootung and which were for sale about ten days ago at a price of $20 for each weapon.

D.S.P.
for y'r info: please
retain.

5.
Thanks
AD

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Thanks

刑事调查处
情报官登记
第 349 号
日期 16/5/20

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

1916年5月18日。

先生：

浙江当局已派遣代理人前往上海，试图购买武器和弹药。

多名掮客正为此事奔走，据他们报告，在上海可以买到12挺机枪，每挺配5000发子弹，总价为2000.00美元；以及15,000支德制1888型毛瑟步枪，每支配500发子弹，单价为60美元。

据称，这些机枪属于一名德国人；步枪的所有者不明，但据说武器储存在浦东的一座仓库中。

所求价格高于浙江方面愿意支付的金额，因为他们收到一项报价，可提供25,000支日本步枪，每支配800发子弹，单价30日元。这些步枪在日本，但如果能筹集到资金，该报价将被接受。

据报道，一家名为高田公司（Takata & Co）的日本商号，地址为博物馆路8号，拥有750支配有刺刀、皮带及250发子弹的步枪，这些武器储存在浦东的一座仓库中，约十天前曾以每支20美元的价格出售。

副警务总监
供你方知悉：请
留存。
15
5.
谢谢
AD

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
首席侦探督察长。

警察总监上尉

谢谢
AP

副本
致
